title.en: Externalities & the tragedy of the commons

description.zh: 当部分成本落在第三方身上，市场按私人成本多生产，无谓损失 = ½·e·(Q_m − Q*)；税率等于边际外部损害的庇古税使福利最大；公地被过度使用；科斯：无成本谈判下权利归谁不影响效率。线性模型，损害为常数。
description.en: When part of the cost falls on a third party the market over-produces, with deadweight loss ½·e·(Q_m − Q*); a Pigouvian tax equal to the marginal damage maximises welfare; commons are overused; Coase: with costless bargaining who holds the right does not change efficiency. A linear model with constant damage.

label.zh: 价格漏掉了一部分成本
label.en: The price leaves out part of the cost

reason.zh: 供需均衡只反映买卖双方的私人成本与好处；加上外部损害后社会成本线高于供给线，均衡就偏离社会最优。
reason.en: Supply–demand equilibrium reflects only the buyers’ and sellers’ private costs and benefits; adding external damage lifts the social cost line above supply and moves equilibrium away from the social optimum.

label.en: The commons is a many-player game

reason.zh: 每个牧民各自最优的选择合起来使总利润下降，这是纳什均衡劣于合作结果的又一例。
reason.en: Each herder’s individually best choice adds up to lower total profit, another case of a Nash equilibrium worse than the cooperative outcome.

label.zh: 均衡之外还要看策略互动

reason.zh: 供需均衡算的是价格把买卖双方撮合到哪；一旦一方的行动影响另一方的收益（公地、污染），就要用博弈论算每个人在对手行动下的最佳回应——外部性问题正是均衡分析走到博弈论的路口。
reason.en: Supply-demand equilibrium computes where price matches buyers and sellers; once one side's action affects another's payoff (commons, pollution), game theory computes each player's best response to rivals' moves — externality problems are exactly where equilibrium analysis meets game theory.

title.zh: 为什么污染和过度捕捞很难靠市场自己解决？
title.en: Why are pollution and overfishing so hard for markets to fix by themselves?

ask.zh: 价格漏掉一部分成本时，市场会多生产还是少生产？无谓损失 ½·e·(Q_m − Q*) 里每个字母是什么意思？
ask.en: When the price leaves out part of the cost, does the market produce too much or too little? In the deadweight loss ½·e·(Q_m − Q*), what does each letter mean?

ask.zh: 均衡价格是两边都愿意交易的交点——如果成本没进价格，这个交点还对吗？
ask.en: The equilibrium price is where both sides plan to trade — if the cost never entered the price, is that crossing point still right?

ask.zh: 公地悲剧为什么是多人博弈？每个人都理性时，为什么结果反而对大家都不好？
ask.en: Why is the tragedy of the commons a many-player game? When everyone is rational, why is the outcome worse for all?

reveal.zh: 部分成本落在第三方身上时，市场按私人成本多生产，无谓损失等于 ½·e·(Q_m − Q*)。庇古税按边际外部损害定价可使福利最大，而科斯指出无成本谈判下权利归谁不影响效率。
reveal.en: When part of the cost falls on a third party the market over-produces on private cost, with deadweight loss ½·e·(Q_m − Q*). A Pigouvian tax equal to the marginal damage maximises welfare, and Coase notes that with costless bargaining who holds the rights does not change efficiency.
